name: Quintanabureba (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a red stripe near the top and a green stripe near the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quintanabureba (a castle, ears of wheat and grapes).
history: Municipal flag of Quintanabureba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Quintanabureba arms — castle, ears of wheat and grapes
